_comment: The one place to change project status. status: Live (a public app or published pack) | Built (code and case study public, no hosted app yet) | Next | Planned. Rendered by assets/site.js on Home and Projects. Stage numbers follow CLAUDE.md section 18.
engagement: One independent, simulated engagement for a fictional hotel group with two properties and synthetic data.

stages.name: Account Research Agent (pre-sales)
stages.summary: A cited brief for a first client meeting; every quote re-checked on its page.
stages.delivers: Before the first meeting: a brief on a hotel company from public web pages, where every line has a source and every quote was checked on its page, plus ten questions, three use-case guesses and a short email.

stages.name: Discovery & Scoping
stages.summary: Stakeholder sessions, use cases scored with a four-check test, SOW, pricing, security answers.
stages.delivers: The discovery, problem selection, statement of work, pricing model and security questionnaire that came before any code.

stages.name: Hotel Operations Knowledge Assistant
stages.summary: Cited, property-specific policy answers for front-desk staff.
stages.delivers: Front-desk staff ask policy questions and get cited, property-specific answers, or an honest "check with a manager".

stages.name: Guest Request Agent
stages.summary: Drafts cited replies to guest emails; staff approve every send.
stages.delivers: An agent that reads guest emails, checks bookings and policy (using stage 1 as a tool) and drafts a reply that staff approve before anything is sent.

stages.name: Eval Harness
stages.summary: One eval harness for both assistants: 181 cases, gates in CI, a judge checked against hand labels.
stages.delivers: One evaluation system for stages 1 and 2: 181 labelled cases, the projects' own metrics, regression gates in both repos' CI, and an LLM judge that counts only once it agrees with hand labels.

stages.name: Production Deployment
stages.summary: Eval-found gaps fixed, redacted persistent logs, budgets in CI, monitoring.
stages.delivers: Both live apps hardened: four gaps the evals found fixed and measured, personal data redacted before storage, a staff role, latency and cost budgets gated in CI, a kill switch and an Operations page.

stages.name: Client Handoff
stages.summary: Runbooks, SLOs and guides the team can own.
stages.delivers: A handoff package for the hotel group's IT and operations teams: architecture, decision index, eight runbooks, SLOs and budgets, staff and admin guides, a readiness checklist, a 30/60/90-day plan and a daily health check.

stages.name: Resort Activities Concierge
stages.summary: Guests ask about today's activities; the agent sends booking requests that staff approve.
stages.delivers: A schedule page and a concierge that answers from the real schedule and policies with citations, sends a booking request only after the guest says yes, and waits for staff to approve it.

stages.name: Hotel Tools MCP Server
stages.summary: The group's tools for any MCP client, with roles, tenant isolation and an audit log.
stages.delivers: An MCP server where an API key's role decides which tools exist and which fields come back, hotel groups can't see each other's data, and every call is audited.

stages.name: Ops Analytics Agent
stages.summary: Plain-English questions over the bookings database, SQL always shown; a daily anomaly check.
stages.delivers: Managers ask the bookings database in plain English and see the SQL behind every answer; a daily check posts anomalies to Slack.
